(ba)༄༅/ /dug dbyung ba bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*/ /rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang*/ /dgra bcom dag gi mthu dag dang*/

tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// dug dbyung ba bzhugs// ༄༅// sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*// rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang*// dgra bcom dag gi mthu dag dang*// gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*// shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang*// mau dgal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang*// ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni// 'od srungs sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// ko'u ḍe n+ya'i sngar thob dang*// kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang*// tshangs pa lha yi byams pa dang*// brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang*// dbang phyug chen po'i stobs dag dang*// sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang*// 'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang*// de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis// bdag gi dug ni dug med shog /dug med dug rnams 'jig byed shog /s+yā d+ya the dan/ ha ri gi shi na ki li/ e he re/ a ma re/ aṇ+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍa re/ ka ṭa ke ke yū re/ ha se ha se ha se/ kha se kha se kha se kha ram̐ ge ma ru ga ha ṇe swā hā/ mu mu k+ṣa swā hā/ hi le swā hā/ mi le swā hā/ 'bras dang rma dang shu ba dang*// g.yan pa dang ni 'brum bu dang*// lhog pa dang ni g.ya' ba ni// bdun pa lags te rab tu bcom// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan chos ni dug mi mnga'// chos kyi gzi yis dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan dge 'dun dug mi mnga'// dge 'dun gzi yis dug bcom mo// sa ni dug gi ma yin te// sa ni dug gi pha yang yin// chu ni dug gi ma yin te// chu ni dug gi pha yang yin// me ni dug gi ma yin te// me ni dug gi pha yang yin// rlung ni dug gi ma yin te// rlung ni dug gi pha yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig de dag gis// bdag gi dug ni dug med shog

/dug ni 'byung ba'i nang du song*// gang ba'i snod du dug song cig swā hā/ dug dbyung ba ste dgu pa'o// //na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na mas+sam̐ ghā ya/ na maḥsu war+ṇa a ba bha sa s+ya ma yū ra rā dz+nye/ na mo ma hā ma yū rā ya bid+yā rā dz+nye/ tad+ya thā/ sid+dhe su sid+dhe/ mo tsa ni/ mo k+ṣa ni/ muk+te/ bi muk+te/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ aṇ+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍa re/ maṅga l+ye/ maṃ ga l+ye/ hi ra ṇ+yai/ hi ra ṇ+ya gar+bhe/ rat+ne/ rat+na gar+bhe/ bha dre su bha dre/ sa man+ta bha dre/ shrī bha dre/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ pa ra mār+tha sā dha ni/ sarba a nar+tha pra ba dha ni/ sarba maṃ ga la sā dha ni/ sarba a maṅga la sā dha ni/ ya sho ba ti/ ma na si/ mā na si/ ma hā mā na sī/ a tsar+yu te/ ad+bhu te/ ad d+yaṃ bhu te/ muk+te/ bi muk+te/ mo tsa ni/ mo shak+ṣa ni/ brah+me/ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ bi ma le/ a mṛ te/ a mṛ ta war+ṣa ni/ a ma re/ a ma ra ṇi/ brah+me brah+ma swa re/ pūr+ṇa ṇe pūr+ṇaṇa ma no ra the/ a mṛ te/ a mṛ ta sañjī wa ni/ shrī bha dre/ tsan+d+re tsan+d+ra pra bhe dre/ sūr+ye sūr+ya kān+te/ bī ta bha ye/ sarba su war+ṇa ṇe/ su war+ṇa ṇa pra bhe/ brah+ma gho ṣe/ brah+ma dzuṣ+ṭe/ sarba tra/ a pra ti ha te swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag dge ba dang*/ bdag la srung bar mdzad du gsol lo// bdag lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig tad+ya thā/ hu tsi shu tsi ghu tsi mu tsi swā hā/ sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug nges par bcom mo// rang sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// dgra bcom pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// phyir mi 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// rgyun tu zhugs pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// bden par smra ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// tshangs pa'i me dbal gyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// dbang po'i rdo rje'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// khyab 'jug gi 'khor los dug bcom mo// gshin rje'i be con gyis dug bcom mo// chu lha'i zhags pas dug bcom mo// lha ma yin gyi sgyus dug bcom mo// klu'i rig sngags kyis dug bcom mo// drag po'i mdung rtses dug bcom mo// skem byed kyi mdung thung gis dug bcom mo// rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mos dug bcom mo// dug nges par bcom mo// dug sa'i nang du song zhig

bdag dug thams cad dang*/ be'u lta bu'i dug dang*/ ha la ha la'i dug dang*/ nag po brtsegs pa'i dug dang*/ mche ba'i dug dang*/ rtsa ba'i dug dang*/ kha zas kyi dug dang*/ phye ma'i dug dang*/ lta ba'i dug dang*/ glog gi dug dang*/ sprin gyi dug dang*/ sbrul dang*/ byi ba dang*/ srin bu ki ta dang*/ lu ta dang*/ ka na bha dang*/ sbal ba dang*/ sbrang bu dang*/ bung ba dang*/ ba ta ri dang*/ tre ma pu ka dang*/ tre la ta'i dug dang*/ mi'i dug dang*/ sdig pa'i dug dang*/ mi ma yin pa'i dug dang*/ dogs pa'i dug dang*/ sman pa'i dug dang*/ rig sngags kyi dug las bde legs su gyur cig dug thams cad las bdag bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ dug dbyung ba gnyis pa ste bcu pa'o// //sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal// chos ni chos ma yin las so// dge 'dun mu stegs byed las rgyal// dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal// lha min zla ba las ni rgyal// nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las// me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal// chu ni me las rgyal bar 'gyur// rlung ni sprin las rab tu rgyal// rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas// sa yang bden par gnas pa lags// sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden// bden pa rgyal 'gyur brdzun ma lags// s+yā d+ya the dan/ a mṛ te/ a gra puṣ+pa ba hu pha le/ ni pā ra ṇi/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ a pa rā dzi te/ ba ra ṭe dhā ra ṇi/ gu h+yā brta te/ gau ta me/ gu gu ta ma ti/ dzam+bha ni swā hā/ pra dzam+bha ni swā hā/ ba la pra bha ñja ni swā hā/ dza ye swā hā/ bi dza ye swā hā/ dza ya bi dza ye swā hā/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu pham// phyir rgol ba ni kun las rgyal swā hā/ rgyal bar byed pa ste bcu gcig pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
